title: Explicit ordinary quotient complexes and their scalar-balancing maps
statement: Let X be a scheme, A a commutative ring in the coefficient universe, J an ideal and U an object of the coefficient-sized pro-etale site. For an integer cochain complex P of A-modules, define L(P) by the actual termwise constant module realization, coefficient extension to the completed constant ring and restriction to U. Define C_n(P) by ordinary termwise scalar extension of L(P) along the restricted completion projection to the constant A/J^(n+1) ring sheaf. Define tau_n by restricting the actual successor coefficient quotient map. The restricted limit cone equation says projection_(n+1) followed by tau_n equals projection_n. The canonical ordinary balancing isomorphism adicFiniteChangeComp, followed by this equality, defines alpha_n(P): change(tau_n) C_(n+1)(P) isomorphic to C_n(P). All complexes, differentials and maps are explicit; no boundedness, flatness, projectivity or derived claim is part of the definition. The derived balancing isomorphism is also exposed with an explicit functor type as adicPerfectDerivedQuotientStep; its value is the existing adicResidueLocalReductionStep.
